question: For the Physics department (Course 8), considering only departments that have more than 10 subjects offered in the 2022FA term, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, the average area, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department, considering only rooms with an area greater than 100? Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH eligible_depts AS (
  SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED
  WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) > 10
),
physics_subjects AS (
  SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.MEET_PLACE
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED s
  WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
    AND s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '8'
    AND s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM eligible_depts)
),
enrollment_stats AS (
  SELECT STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled
  FROM physics_subjects
),
room_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area,
         VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS variance_area,
         STDDEV(r.AREA) AS stddev_area
  FROM physics_subjects ps
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = SUBSTRING_INDEX(ps.MEET_PLACE, '-', 1)
   AND r.ROOM = SUBSTRING_INDEX(ps.MEET_PLACE, '-', -1)
  WHERE r.AREA > 100
)
SELECT 'Physics' AS department_name,
       es.stddev_enrolled,
       rs.avg_area,
       rs.variance_area,
       rs.stddev_area
FROM enrollment_stats es
CROSS JOIN room_stats rs

WITH eligible_depts AS (
  SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED
  WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) > 10
),
physics_subjects AS (
  SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.MEET_PLACE
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED s
  WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
    AND s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '8'
    AND s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM eligible_depts)
),
enrollment_stats AS (
  SELECT STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled
  FROM physics_subjects
),
room_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area,
         VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS variance_area,
         STDDEV(r.AREA) AS stddev_area
  FROM physics_subjects ps
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = SUBSTRING_INDEX(ps.MEET_PLACE, '-', 1)
   AND r.ROOM = SUBSTRING_INDEX(ps.MEET_PLACE, '-', -1)
  WHERE r.AREA > 100
)
SELECT 'Physics' AS department_name,
       es.stddev_enrolled,
       rs.avg_area,
       rs.variance_area,
       rs.stddev_area
FROM enrollment_stats es
CROSS JOIN room_stats rs

WITH dept_subjects AS (
    SELECT
        ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        fr.AREA
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
    LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ccs.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
    WHERE ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8'
      AND ccs.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
),
qualified_depts AS (
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE
    FROM dept_subjects
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
)
SELECT
    ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    STDDEV(ds.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev,
    AVG(ds.AREA) AS avg_area,
    VARIANCE(ds.AREA) AS area_variance,
    STDDEV(ds.AREA) AS area_stddev
FROM dept_subjects ds
JOIN qualified_depts qd ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = qd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE ds.AREA > 100
GROUP BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
